summary: Specifies version 1.3 of Datagram Transport Layer Security, which lets applications communicate over datagram transports while preventing eavesdropping, tampering, and message forgery. It is based on TLS 1.3 and gives equivalent security guarantees, except for protection against reordering or replay of messages. It obsoletes RFC 6347.

eli5.summary: It is a way to send letters that nobody can read or change on the way, even when some letters arrive late or get lost.
